events.title: Steam Next Fest: Livestream of myself playing some temples!
events.summary: Next Fest Livestream!Hello Temple Makers! To celebrate Steam Next Fest, in which Temple Maker 64 participates, I'm presenting a permanent, 24/7 livestream of myself playing some of your temples.This footage is pre-recorded, but feel free to hop into the Discord server if you want to chat!As Next Fest goes on, I will continue exploring some more of your temples, so be sure to check social media as well!

events.title: Tutorial + Character Customisation - Version 0.4.0
events.summary: Hello Temple Makers! New version just dropped in prevision of the upcoming Next Fest, in which Temple Maker 64 will participate!This new version does not implement as much new content as the previous one as I've mostly been focusing on prepping the game for new players, but it does implement a couple features that were long-awaited. events.title: The Grapple Update - Version 0.3.0
events.summary: Hello dear Temple Makers. For the first time since the release of the demo, I'd like to present a brand new item for you to use in your temples!Introducing the GrappleThis tool allows you to pull yourself towards far away targets. If you latch onto certain targets, you will be able to hang from them. If it's on the ceiling, you'll also be able to move up and down!Compatible targets include:New objects: Grapple Target, Grapple Pillar, and Hanging SwitchTreasure ChestsIron BarsTorchesTorch Switche

events.title: Balancing the Imperator + Additional Fixes - Version 0.2.2
events.summary: Hello Temple Makers! I present a first update aimed at balancing the gameplay around the Imperator enemy. Allow me to present the changes I made to its behaviour:Summary of the changesThe shield is now effective against the Imperator's attacks. This change is a counter-measure to the fact that the Imperator's attacks proved too punishing for the average player. If the Imperator blocks your own strikes, though, it will still retaliate very quickly.Imperators now try to block each other's attacks

events.title: The Combat Update - Version 0.2.0
events.summary: Hello dear Temple Makers, allow me to present the biggest update to date!Check out some of the new features in this update:Introducing the ImperatorThe Imperator is a reptilian creature with a two-handed longsword that will attack you on sight. It moves fast, so escaping it is difficult. Unless you time it right, it will parry most of your attacks and retaliate immediately. events.title: Better-looking, faster-loading Temples - 0.0.16 update
events.summary: In this new update, major changes were made in the way temples are shaded. It might not seem like much, but it should in fact optimise very large temples and get rid of the remaining lag spikes you may encounter. Here's a breakdown.Introducing a shiny, brand new AO algorithmWhat's AO, anywayAO stands for Ambient Occlusion, and it corresponds to the darker shading that you can see along the corners of the rooms.
